title: Write a longest_increasing_run function (hard)
prompt: Write a Python function `longest_increasing_run(nums)` that returns the length of the longest strictly increasing consecutive run in a list of numbers.

metadata.hard_reason: Off-by-one errors are common here - e.g. [1,2,2,3] should give 2 (the run breaks at the repeated 2), not 3; also check empty-list and single-element edge cases.
metadata.notes: Correct: tracks a running count that resets when the sequence stops strictly increasing, keeping the max seen. No sandboxed execution yet; graded manually.
